name: Sour Pickle Interior
notes: morning sun through the front windows, warm and cheerful, no text legible anywhere

compiled.description: the small bright dining room of a tiny family diner - exposed red brick down one long wall, sunflower-yellow painted walls, mismatched framed pictures and green pickle drawings hung close together, six or seven small tables with speckled green terrazzo tops and bentwood chairs, fresh flowers in little vases on every table, potted plants and window boxes along a tall sunlit front window, a stainless kitchen pass and a pastry case at the back, a shelf of children's books, lived-in and worn, morning sun through the front windows, warm and cheerful, no text legible anywhere
